newsitem.title: USA: Ross hired for muni research at Dain Bosworth.
newsitem.headline: Ross hired for muni research at Dain Bosworth.

text.p: Michael Ross has joined Dain Bosworth Inc as a managing director of municipal research here.

Ross, who formerly worked as vice president and director of municipal research at ABN AMRO Securities in Chicago, will provide research on the secondary muni market and on competitive new issues, according to a press release from the Minneapolis-based firm.
Ross will also be charged with generating trading ideas for Dain Bosworth's institutional and individual investor clients, the release added.
